item.title: What Does Discipleship in Disability Ministry Look Like?
item.description: Growing up with a sister with Down syndrome is the catalyst for my current ministry calling—helping churches take steps of accessibility so people with disabilities and their families can attend.

item.title: The Reality Behind Our Culture’s Favorite Mantra
item.description: Surely you’ve seen the simple, uplifting mantra for our times: “You Are Enough.” But have you stopped to consider why this phrase, in these settings, is this popular?

item.title: ​​What Is the Most Helpful Way for the Church to Minister to Teens?
item.description: It’s important for younger members of the church not to feel like they're just passive consumers of the church, but that they're, in fact, active participants in the church.

item.title: A Poem for Those in Despair
item.description: The dispeller of despair is Jesus, his eyes closed in the storm but his heart open toward us. That storm, it turns out, is the triumph of his art.

item.title: Introducing the ‘Everyday Gospel Easter Devotional’ by Paul David Tripp
item.description: Celebrate Easter with 30 devotionals from Paul David Tripp that connect Scripture to everyday life.

item.title: How to Respond to Personal Offenses in the Church
item.description: Striving for reconciliation with others demands that I love Jesus and his church more than I love nursing my sense of offense.

item.title: What Comes to Mind When You Think About the Bible?
item.description: The shape of our worship and the course of our lives are dictated by our sense of what God is like. What if this is equally true regarding our view of Scripture, God’s word?

item.title: Podcast: Misconceptions About Persecution in the Church (Matt Rhodes)
item.description: Matt Rhodes discusses what persecution looks like today and how this has affected missionaries and the global church.

item.title: What Is the Difference Between Doubt and Unbelief?
item.description: If you’ve lived the Christian life very long as a believer, you know that every Christian, at some point or another, has that moment where they wonder whether the things they believe are really true.
